mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO posts a 3-month decline of > 2pp but SPX returns are not significantly negative over the next 60 days (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises by > 10% y-o-y but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, it signals a weakening labor market that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp m-o-m but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) both rise by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals a tightening monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise by > 0.5% m-o-m but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) both post year-over-year declines of more than 1%, it signals a broad economic slowdown that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO both post y-o-y declines of > 1% but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.
